display.title: Shavuos: Everyone Comes to Hear the Ten Commandments
display.summary_short: Just as every Jew, young and old, stood at Har Sinai, everyone should come to shul on Shavuos to hear the Ten Commandments read and say Naaseh V'nishma together.
display.summary_long: A Shavuos talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given a few days before the holiday. Uncle Yossi explains that Shavuos is when we celebrate the giving and receiving of the Torah, and urges children to come to shul on the first day, and to bring friends and anyone they know, even the smallest children, to hear the Ten Commandments read from the Torah. When the Jewish people left Mitzrayim, not one Jew stayed behind, and at Har Sinai every single Jew, young and old, was there. Each year we relive that moment of achdus, one united nation receiving the one Torah from the One G-d, and again declare Naaseh V'nishma, 'we will do and we will listen'. When Hashem sees us gathered together in shul, He blesses us, and we pray that the blessing include the coming of Moshiach.
display.lesson: Come to shul on Shavuos with everyone you know to hear the Ten Commandments, and accept the Torah again together with Naaseh V'nishma.
